name: Zscaler
description: Zscaler sells cloud-delivered cybersecurity: its Zero Trust Exchange sits between every user, device, workload or AI agent and the applications or internet they reach, replacing firewalls and VPNs at the edge of a company network. Customers (about 11,000, including over 40% of the Forbes Global 2000) pay a subscription priced mainly per user and by metered usage, on one-to-five-year contracts recognized evenly over the term; 98% of revenue is subscription and support. Revenue grew 25% to $3.35 billion in the year to July 2026 and annual recurring revenue reached $3.77 billion, but GAAP results are slightly negative (operating loss $133 million) because of about $0.84 billion of stock-based pay; non-GAAP operating margin was 23%. It is adding products by acquisition (Red Canary managed detection and response, bought for $651 million in August 2025) and by AI-security launches.

hq.note: FY2026 10-K Item 2: San Jose is the current headquarters; the company moves to a new headquarters in Santa Clara, California (about 301,000 sq ft, sublease to April 30, 2032) during fiscal Q1 2027. The EDGAR business address already reads 4401 Great America Parkway, Santa Clara.

employees.note: "over 8,700 employees" (FY2026 10-K Item 1), so 8,700 is a floor; about 60% of full-time employees are outside the US.

businessLines.name: Zero Trust SASE (ZIA, ZPA, Zero Trust Browser, ZDX, Zero Trust Branch, Zero Trust Cloud)
businessLines.how: Annual-recurring subscription priced mainly per user and by metered usage, usually one to five years, mostly non-cancelable and recognized ratably; growth comes from more users, more products per customer, and price.
businessLines.description: Zscaler Internet Access (secure internet, SaaS and AI-app access), Zscaler Private Access (access to internal apps without a VPN), browser security, digital experience monitoring, and branch and cloud-workload connectivity.

businessLines.name: Security for AI
businessLines.how: Add-on subscription sold into the existing base of ZIA and ZPA customers (the 10-K names Security for AI as a follow-on sale).
businessLines.description: Discovering, governing and protecting AI applications, models, agents and data across the enterprise.

businessLines.name: Data Security
businessLines.how: Add-on subscription sold into the existing base; the 10-K names Data Security as a typical follow-on sale to ZIA or ZPA customers.
businessLines.description: Data loss prevention (including email DLP), data security posture management and related controls across data's life cycle.

businessLines.name: Agentic Security Operations
businessLines.how: Subscription for managed detection and response and security-operations software; partly a service sold per customer.
businessLines.description: AI-driven tools for security-operations and IT-operations teams; Red Canary (managed detection and response, acquired August 1, 2025) is the largest purchase behind it.

brands.name: Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange (ZIA, ZPA, ZDX and other modules)
brands.share: About 98% of revenue is subscription and support on this platform; module split not reported

brands.name: Red Canary
brands.note: Acquired 2025-08-01 for $651.4M cash. Together with SPLXAI (acquired 2025-10-31), SquareX (2026-02-05) and Symmetry Systems (2026-05-27, $152.9M cash), about 4.4% of FY2026 revenue.

whatsNext.text: Move of corporate headquarters from San Jose to Santa Clara during fiscal Q1 2027 (August to October 2026); the San Jose sublease expires October 31, 2026
